'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Physician for [[Xuanfang Huaxu Academy]] who is first seen treating a Xuanfang Warden.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(One time interaction)
:'''Zhengzhuang:''' Doctor, what should I do!? I think I've got a terminal illness!!

:'''[[Fuchang]]:''' Don't panic. Take deep breaths. What symptoms are you experiencing?

:'''Zhengzhuang:''' Every time I go on shift at the Censure Court, I get so dizzy I see spots! My heart pounds like a drum! The air grows heavy, like an invisible hand is choking me!

:'''Zhengzhuang:''' I've looked through so many medical texts and don't see anything matching it! It must be a rare disease. There's a nine in ten chance i-it's a terminal illness!

:'''Fuchang:''' Let me check your pulse... take off your mask and stick out your tongue.

:'''Fuchang:''' ...

:'''Fuchang:''' Hmm... Your illness. I believe I know what it is.

:'''Zhengzhuang:''' What? So I am sick? I knew it! Is there a cure, doctor? Give it to me straight. I-I can take it.

:'''Fuchang:''' There is a cure. I'll write you a prescription, but this prescription isn't for your eyes. Take it to your captain.

:'''Fuchang:''' The next time you go on shift at the Censure Court, do whatever your captain tells you. Understand?

:'''Zhengzhuang:''' Of course! I'll do exactly as you say!
{{Dialogue End}}
